Subject: Satellite demo runway — co-hosted microsessions with Aurora Consulting

Hi Samir / Aurora team,

It was great meeting at EdgeSummit last month — I wanted to follow up with a lightweight proposal to run a co-hosted ‘satellite demo runway’: three 20-minute microsessions (live, short-demos + q&a) timed to Aurora’s customer webinar series, and a short pre-recorded demo clip for social. Goal: get product-led engineers and platform buyers exposure to Redwood inference in hands-on snippets while Aurora leads the demand channel.

High-level proposal (attached: satellite_runway_onepager.pdf):
- Pilot: 1x 20-min live microsession (co-host) + 1x 3-min pre-recorded demo clip
- Audience: Aurora customers + opt-in developer list (estimated 400–800 reach)
- Redwood commitments: 12-min demo + 8-min live q&a, landing page co-branded, 1 slide + short follow-up email
- Aurora commitments: promo across newsletter and 2 social posts, registration list, host moderation

Dates we’re thinking: week of Dec 15 or Dec 22 for a pilot. We can scale to a monthly cadence in Q1 if the pilot hits.

Can you confirm interest and preferred pilot date windows? If yes, I’ll loop in Marissa (marketing) and Ben (field) to lock logistics and assets.

Thanks —
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0129

Priyom — great to hear from you and love the idea. Aurora is actively looking for tighter product demos that convert into trial leads; a short, technical demo run fits that need.

A few quick questions before we lock a date:
- Audience mix: do you have a breakdown estimate (dev vs infra vs product)?
- Promo: can Redwood commit to a single dedicated email + 2 social posts? We’ll amplify with our newsletter and a banner on the Aurora learning site.
- Speaker: can you share a 1-line bio for the Redwood lead and 2 slide bullets we can pull into our landing page?

We have light availability the week of Dec 15 for a pilot. Dec 22 looks risky because many clients are OOO. If Dec 15 works, we can treat the session as a ‘pilot microsession’ and, if successful, schedule a recurring spot in Q1.

Looping in our events coordinator (DevNest handle in cc) — can you please include Marissa and Ben from Redwood so we can coordinate landing page and speaker assets?

—Samir
